answer: Pay mining rewards into a 30-epoch escrow. Each epoch a public beacon picks 5% of escrowed answers for audit: three random peers compare each one with every other key's work through a prism of phrasing, submit timing and funding source. A confirmed fake forfeits its whole escrow, plus 20% from any key that funded it, so one catch sends a ripple through the farm. Peers who whisper a valid lead to auditors get 10% of the clawback. With 100 fakes, odds of zero audits over 30 epochs are near nil.
